note: The arithmetic-coded input bitstream controls decoded coefficient value v, which is stored into the DCT coefficient block used by the transform path.
The transformed coefficient block is passed to the baseline Huffman encoder for recompression.
The encoder computes the magnitude bit count for an AC coefficient but does not reject values exceeding the representable range for the JPEG data precision before using nbits to index Huffman tables.
The unchecked coefficient magnitude nbits is combined with the zero run length to form the AC Huffman symbol index.
When the unchecked index exceeds the 256-entry AC Huffman lookup table, the encoder reads adjacent uninitialized memory, producing the MSan use-of-uninitialized-value.
